description: This file implements the HttpClient class, which provides functionality for downloading files over HTTP using libcurl. It includes methods for performing downloads, handling progress updates, and resource management of curl handles.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class encapsulating HTTP download functionality using libcurl, supporting file downloads with progress tracking and rate limiting.

methods.description: Downloads a file from a given URL to a specified filename with optional rate limiting.

methods.description: Static callback responsible for writing downloaded data to a file.
